instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.68(1)(a)6 requires itemizing the name/address of a lobbyist and the total paid to that lobbyist only if lobbying expenditures/obligations to that lobbyist exceed $200 during the reporting period.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled Wisconsin provisions define 'lobbyist' by receipt of 'economic consideration' and a 5-days-of-communications test (s. 13.62(11)) but do not set any compensation dollar threshold triggering lobbyist registration/licensure.

The bundled text contains principal expenditure thresholds (e.g., registration at >$500 under s. 13.64(1)) but does not define lobbyist status/licensure based on a lobbyist's own lobbying expenditures in dollars.

The bundled sections impose filing (expense statement) obligations on principals (s. 13.68) and do not establish any lobbyist-side de minimis dollar threshold exempting a lobbyist from filing disclosure.

The statute provides a 5-days-per-reporting-period test for who is a 'lobbyist' when duties are not exclusively lobbying (s. 13.62(11)), but the bundled text does not create a lobbyist disclosure-filing exemption based on a percentage of compensated time devoted to lobbying.
